answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 16 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 700 identities costs 700 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The delta of the design is public, the sable of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the sparrow of honest work is what finally pays.
